SYMPTOM: App tests fail because onboarding screen covers the main UI, or keyboard setup sheet covers tab bar
CAUSE: @AppStorage('hasSeenOnboarding') and keyboardBannerDismissed persist. On fresh simulator, onboarding appears. Keyboard setup sheet auto-presents on Settings tab. Banner covers tab bar and intercepts taps.
FIX: All app flows start with:
  - runFlow when visible 'onboarding.skip' identifier → tap skip
  - After banner dismissed once (AppStorage=true), Settings tab shows normally
PATTERN: Tab navigation test must dismiss the keyboard banner BEFORE navigating tabs — banner intercepts taps and re-triggers the sheet
NOTE: Once dismissed, these states persist across test runs on the same simulator
